sentences.text: ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MRS. JUSTICE SUNITA AGARWAL)
[1] Draft amendment filed today is taken on record.
The same is hereby allowed.
Necessary incorporation be made in the array of parties within the course of the day.

[2] The petitioner herein seeks modification of the Award dated 08.03.2021 passed in LAQ Case No.
04 / 2019 in respect of the land bearing Survey No. 786 / 1 of Village - Palasava, Taluka Momaya Petha Solanki vs State Of Gujarat on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106312669/
1 - Rapar, District - Kachchh, on the ground that the name of the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/9933/2024 ORDER DATED: 09/07/2024 undefined petitioner herein is recorded as the owner of the land in question by Mutation Entry dated 10.07.2023.
It is stated in the writ petition that the petitioner had purchased the land in question namely Survey No. 786 / 1, total admeasuring 10,218 sq.mts by virtue of the Sale Deed dated 20.05.2004.

The land in question was acquired vide Notification under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 published on 13.11.2019.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The Award determining compensation has been made on 08.03.2021.
[3] A perusal of the record indicates that the name of the petitioner was initially mutated on 12.04.2013 by Mutation Entry No. 7638.

However, the same was cancelled vide Mutation Entry No.
7638 dated 08.08.2013, inasmuch as, at the relevant point of time, there was encumbrance of the bank over the subject land and the title of the land was not clear.
[4] The result is that the names of the original owners / vendors continued in the Revenue Record till the year 2023.
It is thus evident that on the date of acquisition of the land in question, there was clout on the title of the petitioner.

It seems that in an appeal filed by the petitioner under Rule 108 (5) of the Gujarat Land Revenue Rules before the Deputy Collector, Bhachau against the Mutation Entry No. 10141 dated 02.11.2017 of the Entry of the names of heirs of original owner / seller, by Order dated 10.07.2023, entry has been made in the name of the petitioner.
NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/9933/2024 ORDER DATED: 09/07/2024 undefined [5] Be that as it may, there is no clarity about the encumbrance of the bank over the land in question.
The right of the petitioner to receive compensation on the date of acquisition i.e. making of the Award on 10.08.2021 is not clear.
[6] Moreover, there is a substantial delay in filing of the instant petition seeking for modification of the Award dated 08.03.2021.
For the mere fact that there is correction in the mutation entry at the subsequent point of time, we have serious doubt about the right of the petitioner to receive compensation.
No positive direction, as such, can be given.

The writ petition is, accordingly,
dismissed.

(SUNITA AGARWAL, CJ ) (PRANAV TRIVEDI,J) SAHIL S. RANGER Momaya Petha Solanki vs State Of Gujarat on 9 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/106312669/
